title: How Safari Guides in Tanzania Are Trained
excerpt: How do safari guides in Tanzania become guides? Training, licences and the experience behind a good guide.
body:
## Training

Many guides follow courses at wildlife and tourism colleges in Tanzania, covering animals, ecology, first aid, driving and hospitality.

## Licence

Professional guides need the right licences to drive and guide tourists in the parks.

## Experience

Most guides start as assistants or drivers and grow with experience.

## Languages

English is standard; some guides speak other languages, such as German, French or Dutch.

## Ongoing learning

Good guides keep learning, from birds to photography.

See [what a good guide does](/blog/meet-your-safari-guide/) or [plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
